AdminSummary.description: The authenticated admin account. Never contains the password hash.
AdminSummary.title: AdminSummary

BookingChangeTime.description:
Move a NEW/WAITING booking, or change only the end of any booking (§26).

Omitting ``starts_at`` (or sending the booking's current start) performs an
end-only change: allowed for NEW/WAITING and for OPEN before its plan end.
BookingChangeTime.title: BookingChangeTime

BookingCreate.description:
Admin manual create (§19). ``ONLINE`` is reserved for the public flow (§8).

Times are absolute ISO-8601 instants; the backend derives the business date
and the shift snapshot from the canonical schedule resolver.
BookingCreate.title: BookingCreate

BookingEventSummary.description: One append-only history row; payload holds no PII (§6.10).
BookingEventSummary.title: BookingEventSummary

BookingSummary.description: Booking representation for the admin book (no idempotency keys/HMACs).
BookingSummary.title: BookingSummary

BookingTableAdd.description: Add one or more tables to a NEW/WAITING/OPEN booking (§20).
BookingTableAdd.title: BookingTableAdd

BookingTableReplace.title: BookingTableReplace

BusinessDayResponse.description: Computed schedule state for one business date (PROJECT-SPEC §5.1, §5.6).
BusinessDayResponse.title: BusinessDayResponse

HallDetail.description: A hall with its tables and static elements (read-only canvas source).
HallDetail.title: HallDetail

HallSummary.description: Hall metadata (canvas size, revision, archive state).
HallSummary.title: HallSummary

HallUpdate.description: Editable hall fields. ``is_bookable`` does not bump the layout revision.
HallUpdate.title: HallUpdate

LayoutSaveRequest.description:
Full-state editor layout-save for one hall (§31).

``is_bookable`` is deliberately absent on both levels: it is an operational
flag changed via separate mutations and never bumps ``layout_revision``.
LayoutSaveRequest.title: LayoutSaveRequest

LayoutSaveTable.description: One table row in a layout-save payload (§31, editor-owned fields only).
LayoutSaveTable.title: LayoutSaveTable

OutboxDeadJob.description: A DEAD outbox job for the operational banner/list (§6.11, §49).
OutboxDeadJob.title: OutboxDeadJob

OutboxDeadList.description: The venue's DEAD jobs plus the unacknowledged count for the banner.
OutboxDeadList.title: OutboxDeadList

PublicCreateRequest.description:
Public ONLINE booking create payload (§18, §42).

The ``honeypot`` field is hidden in the UI and must be empty for a normal
user (§40, §50). ``captcha_token`` is only required when the CAPTCHA feature
flag is enabled.
PublicCreateRequest.title: PublicCreateRequest

PublicCreateResponse.description:
Public booking confirmation (§50).

Shows only what the success screen needs: booking number, venue, date, time,
hall, table, party size. No guest name/phone/comment is returned to avoid
leaking PII back through the public response (§36, §42).
PublicCreateResponse.title: PublicCreateResponse

PublicHall.description: Public hall with canvas geometry, static elements and active tables.
PublicHall.title: PublicHall

PublicVenueResponse.description: Public venue data for the booking UI (§34, §50).
PublicVenueResponse.title: PublicVenueResponse

ScheduleDay.description: One weekday rule. ``is_open=false`` means the day is closed.
ScheduleDay.title: ScheduleDay

ScheduleExceptionUpdate.description: A date-specific override; it fully replaces the weekly rule (§5.3).
ScheduleExceptionUpdate.title: ScheduleExceptionUpdate

SettingsUpdate.description:
Editable venue settings.

``slug``, ``timezone`` and ``is_active`` are intentionally absent: slug and
timezone are not runtime-editable in v1, and suspension is a CLI operation.
SettingsUpdate.title: SettingsUpdate

TableUpdate.description: Operational table toggle. Geometry is owned by layout-save, not here (§35).
TableUpdate.title: TableUpdate

VKIntegrationSummary.description: Secret-free VK integration view. Never exposes the access token (§38.5).
VKIntegrationSummary.title: VKIntegrationSummary

VKIntegrationUpdate.description:
Configure the venue's VK integration (§38.5).

``access_token`` is optional on update: omitting it keeps the stored token, so
toggling ``enabled`` or changing the peer does not require re-entering the
secret. A supplied token is encrypted at rest and never read back.
VKIntegrationUpdate.title: VKIntegrationUpdate

VenueSummary.description: Public identity of the tenant the session belongs to.
VenueSummary.title: VenueSummary

WeeklyScheduleUpdate.description: Full replacement of the weekly schedule (all seven weekdays).
WeeklyScheduleUpdate.title: WeeklyScheduleUpdate

info.description:
Takeplace HTTP API.

* Public booking API: `/api/public/v1`
* Admin API: `/api/admin/v1`
* Health: `/health/live`, `/health/ready`, `/health/ops`

This OpenAPI document is the single source of API transport types for the
frontend. Types are generated with `openapi-typescript` and never edited by hand.
info.title: Takeplace API

post.description:
Authenticate and start a server-side session.

Wrong login and wrong password return the same response (§39.5). Two cheap
rate limits run before the CPU-bound Argon2id verify so the bounded pool
cannot be saturated by garbage logins.
Revoke the current session and clear the cookie.
Revoke every session of this venue, including the current one.

get.description: Cursor/limit list with the §35 filters (newest first).

post.description:
Create a manual booking idempotently (§19, §32.2).

A fresh booking is ``201``; a replay of the same key+payload is ``200`` with
the same booking identity and no new side effects (§36).

get.description: NEW/WAITING bookings whose planned interval has already ended (§17.3).
Return one booking of this venue, or 404 for any other tenant (§7.1).

post.description: Cancel an unopened booking; deactivates its occupancies (§9, §13).
Reschedule a NEW/WAITING booking, or change an end time (§5.5, §26).

get.description: Return the append-only history ordered by ``booking_events.id`` (§6.10).

post.description: Atomically replace/reseat tables, `remove old + add new` (§20.6).
Add tables to a NEW/WAITING booking (plan) or OPEN booking (live) (§20).

delete.description: Remove one table from a NEW/WAITING booking (plan) or OPEN booking (§20.5).

get.description: List this venue's halls (archived halls are hidden unless requested).

post.description: Create a hall (canvas) for this venue.

get.description: Return one hall with its tables (including archived) and static elements.

post.description: Archive a hall; blocked while it still has non-archived tables (§29.5).

put.description:
Apply a full-state editor layout-save for one hall (PROJECT-SPEC §31).

The payload carries ``expected_revision`` plus the complete editor-owned
state (canvas size, tables, static elements). A stale revision returns
``409 LAYOUT_STALE`` without writing anything; the commit also emits a
``resync`` realtime signal, so a second admin device refetches instead of
silently overwriting the winner.

get.description: Return this venue's VK integration as a secret-free summary.

put.description: Upsert this venue's VK integration, encrypting any supplied token (§38.5).

get.description:
Return the authenticated admin and its venue.

The venue is derived from the session, never from a client-supplied id.
List this venue's DEAD outbox jobs plus the unacknowledged count.

post.description: Acknowledge a DEAD job so it stops degrading ``/health/ops`` (§38.3).
Requeue a DEAD/RETRY job for immediate retry without extending its TTL (§38.3).

get.description: Return this venue's weekly schedule (all seven weekdays).

put.description:
Replace the weekly schedule, validating grid rules and adjacent overlaps.

The request must define every weekday; a shift that crosses midnight is
expressed as ``close_time < open_time`` (§5.2). A schedule whose adjacent
shifts would overlap is rejected with ``SCHEDULE_OVERLAP`` (§5.4).

get.description:
Return the computed state for a business date (§5.1, §5.6).

With no ``business_date`` the *current* business date is used — which may be
yesterday's date while an overnight shift is still running.
Return this venue's date-specific schedule exceptions.

delete.description: Delete the exception for one date, reverting to the weekly rule (§5.3).

put.description: Create or replace the exception for one business date (§5.3).

get.description: Return this venue's settings.

patch.description:
Update this venue's editable settings.

Only fields the client sent are applied (PATCH semantics); an unknown field
such as ``venue_id`` is dropped by the schema and can never retarget the
mutation (PROJECT-SPEC §7.1).

get.description: Open the admin realtime stream for the session's venue (§37.1).

200.description: Realtime refetch signals for the session's venue.

get.description: Flat list of this venue's tables for the list view, with hall names.

patch.description: Operational ``is_bookable`` toggle; geometry is owned by layout-save (§35).

post.description: Archive a table; the live/future-occupancy guard lands with Stage 5 (§29.3).

get.description: Return only public venue/hall/table data for one tenant (§34).
Return a read-only availability snapshot for one venue/date selection (§16, §34).

post.description:
Create a public ONLINE booking idempotently (§18, §18.2, §32.2).

The client must send:

* ``Idempotency-Key``: a UUID generated once per user action and reused for
  network retries of the same action;
* ``honeypot``: must be empty for a normal user (§40, §50).

The server follows the §18.2 ordering: cheap transport guards, slug resolve,
CAPTCHA hook, soft rate limit, then delegation to the booking core which does
the idempotency lookup before mutable gates, the kill-switch final gate, and
the transactional create under the canonical lock order.

400.description: missing or invalid Idempotency-Key / honeypot / captcha

409.description: idempotency key reused, booking conflict, or online disabled

get.description: Process liveness: no dependency checks.

Operational health for external monitoring.

Always returns 200 so monitoring can distinguish "degraded" from "down".
Readiness: the app can serve requests and sees a working database.
